name: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
headline: Amazon Textract Insights extracts grounded fields from documents
lede: You can describe the fields you want in plain language and get structured results with a confidence score and page-level grounding for each value, with no model training.

effects.effect: Grounded confidence scores make extraction review cheaper
Reduces need to train custom document models

possibilities.title: Document teams can route hard table pages to a second reader using confidence scores

with.title: Gemini 4 Neon tops ParseBench-2 table parsing

possibilities.connection: Textract Insights gives each extracted value a confidence score and page grounding, and ParseBench-2 names Gemini 4 Neon at low thinking as the top recent model on tables and visual layout, so low-confidence table values can be re-read by the best table parser and compared.
